none: PAS SWYOR-9B1961: Roman coin; nummus of the House of Constantine, VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP
contea di ritrovamento: Northamptonshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Roman coin; a nummus of the House of Constantine, possibly Constantine I, dating from AD 318 - 320 (Reece Period 16), VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP reverse type showing two Victories holding a wreath inscribed VOT / PR with an altar between them. Mint unknown
